usedFor: Easybill holds invoicing documents, and Kylas CRM opens a deal through “Create Deal” when “New Document Created” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Document Created” in Easybill, then “Create Deal” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: Billing activity in Easybill reaches the sales team as a deal in Kylas CRM.

watchOut: “Project Updated” also comes from Easybill, so pair “Create Deal” with “New Document Created” to avoid edit duplicates.
